tasks.title: Set up project structure and npm verify script
tasks.description: Initialize static HTML/CSS/JS project with npm package.json and implement core verify script for proof plans.
tasks.details: Create package.json with scripts: 'verify' using Node.js to read index.html and required files, check for exact phrases using cheerio or simple fs.readFileSync + regex/string includes. Ensure deterministic output. Structure: /index.html, /css/style.css, /js/script.js, /AGENTS.md. No frameworks. npm init -y; npm i cheerio.
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm run verify' twice, confirm identical output; manually remove phrase, verify it fails.

tasks.title: Implement Phrase + Intuition hero section
tasks.description: Build above-the-fold hero with unforgettable prime directive phrase: 'If it doesn't run, it doesn't exist.'
tasks.details: Use large bold font in index.html header, ensure visible at 1366x768 without scroll. CSS: position fixed/sticky if needed, responsive font-size with clamp(). Add intuition text embodying Propose->Patch->Prove->Pack.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks phrase exists; open in browser at 1366x768, confirm no scroll needed.

tasks.details:

tasks.title: Develop One-minute Example section
tasks.description: Demonstrate invariant -> test -> proof loop with simple copy-paste example.
tasks.details: HTML section with headline, short code block showing propose-patch-prove-pack. Use <pre><code> for readability. Time it to <60s read.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks headline + key lines; manual timed read-through <60s.

tasks.title: Build Funnel Illustration section
tasks.description: Visualize proposals filtered by oracles using ASCII art funnel.
tasks.details: HTML <pre> block with monospace ASCII funnel art (e.g., wide top proposals -> narrow bottom proofs). CSS ensure monospace font, legible on mobile.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks funnel text block; view on mobile, confirm monospace readability.

tasks.title: Implement Roles -> Constraints Mapping
tasks.description: Map FE/BE/QA roles to constraints + oracles table.
tasks.details: HTML table or definition list: e.g., 'Frontend Constraint: UI responsive -> Oracle: npm test viewport'. Action-oriented terms.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks mapping terms; manual review lists >=2 oracles per constraint.

tasks.title: Add Control Theory Lens section
tasks.details: HTML section with titles/subheads defining terms: sensors (oracles), actuators (patches), controller (propose/prove). Tie to loop.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks section titles; manual check each term defined on page.

tasks.title: Create Paste-ins for Claude instructions and AGENTS.md
tasks.description: Add copy-paste blocks for Claude prompts and AGENTS.md operating rules.
tasks.details: HTML <pre> blocks with content. JS copy-to-clipboard buttons using navigator.clipboard.writeText(). Create AGENTS.md file with rules. Verify script checks both.
tasks.testStrategy: npm run verify checks paste-in content; click copy, paste into editor confirms.

tasks.title: Implement responsive CSS layout and mobile optimization
tasks.description: Ensure entire page single-column responsive, readable in <2min, mobile-first.
tasks.details: CSS: mobile-first media queries, max-width 375px single col, font sizes scale, no horizontal scroll. Sections stack vertically.
tasks.testStrategy: Manual: finish page <2min, recall phrase; test 375px width, 1366x768.

tasks.title: Enhance npm verify for all proof plans and success criteria
tasks.description: Extend verify script to cover all sections, phrases, files; fails on removal.
tasks.details: Cheerio parse index.html, assert selectors/text for each req (hero phrase, diff h2s, etc.). Check AGENTS.md exists/phrases. Console.log pass/fail.
tasks.testStrategy: Remove required phrases/files one-by-one, confirm verify fails; full run passes.
